_about: Weeks whose full (rank, song) ordering repeats the previous week, triaged and accepted. verify_charts.py reports these as warnings; anything not listed here fails the run. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_top100: Every one is a New Year week, when Billboard historically republished the prior week's chart rather than compiling a new one. The sibling AC, country and alternative charts show 14-day publication gaps at the same dates, which is the same holiday behaviour recorded a different way. Genuine, not corrupt.
_albums200: Same New Year republication as top100.
_radio: New Year weeks, first two years of the chart's life, and the same dates top100 and albums200 already carry. Re-dated from 1990-12-26/1991-12-25 when the Wednesday-dated weeks were shifted to Billboard's real Saturday dates. Both were re-checked at source: Billboard serves each with its own 'Week of' heading and a full ~1.98 MB page, so the repeated ranking is a genuine frozen holiday chart, not a clamp.
